comment: Shared hand_floor guard fixture (ADR-0061 decision 3c, issue 3063). Agents are 1 (Ada), 2 (Bo) and 3 (Cy); 9 is not an agent. Each case routes a person's message to `first` (then `routed`), runs `steps` (hand_floor calls; a step whose `from` is not the live turn's agent first commits the live turn and starts the queued hand-off to `from`), then the last call with `consults`. `want` is the last call's answer. The turntaking unit test, the cloud listener's repository (HandFloorInExchange) and the desktop's handLocalFloor each run every case; `local_only` cases use consults, which the cloud exchange does not have (cloud consults are worker sub-agents).

cases.name: two agents in one call, in order
an agent outside the thread is refused
a routed agent's later turn counts
a third turn of one agent stops the exchange
a chain hands back and the guard stops the third turn
consults count toward the pair guard
consults are not turns of the consulted agent
